name: Roborock Saros 20
summary: A low-profile vacuum and mop with a lifting chassis for homes with difficult transitions.
fit: Homes where low furniture and room thresholds interrupt daily robot cleaning.
caution: Measure every transition: the maximum double-step claim is not a single vertical step rating.

facts.label: Body height
facts.meaning: Measure the lowest point beneath furniture, including rails.

facts.label: Suction claim
facts.meaning: A manufacturer peak figure, not a comparable pickup score.

facts.label: Navigation
facts.meaning: Check obstacle handling against your actual clutter.

facts.label: Chassis
facts.meaning: Threshold shape matters as much as total height.

faq.question: Can Saros 20 climb an 8.8 cm step?
faq.answer: Roborock describes a double-layer threshold: the first rise is at most 4.5 cm, the gap is over 12 cm and at most 14 cm, and the second rise is at most 4.3 cm. Do not apply 8.8 cm to one vertical obstacle.

launchNote: Unveiled in Roborock’s CES 2026 lineup; local availability varies.

name: Dreame X60 Ultra
summary: A slim vacuum and mop platform pairing high advertised suction with an automated mop-care dock.
fit: Mixed-floor homes looking for low-clearance access and less daily mop handling.
caution: Check carpet behavior, dock access and local consumable costs before using peak suction to choose.

facts.label: Body height
facts.meaning: Allow extra clearance for real furniture and uneven floors.

facts.label: Suction claim
facts.meaning: Peak suction does not establish cleaning superiority.

facts.label: Dock wash
facts.meaning: This refers to mop self-cleaning, not floor temperature.

facts.label: Brush system
facts.meaning: Inspect brush-end maintenance as well as hair pickup.

faq.question: Does X60 Ultra wash the floor at 100°C?
faq.answer: No. The cited temperature describes the dock’s mop-cleaning process. It should not be presented as the temperature applied to your floor.

launchNote: Dreame named both X60 Ultra and X60 Max Ultra Complete in its CES 2026 announcement. Regional packages differ.

name: ECOVACS DEEBOT X12 OmniCyclone
summary: A roller-mop robot built around stain treatment, edge contact and bagless dock dust collection.
fit: Hard-floor homes where food stains and edge mopping matter in the buying decision.
caution: Check roller access, dirty-water handling and carpet protection; automated washing still needs upkeep.

facts.label: Mop roller
facts.meaning: Roller coverage matters alongside how often it is rinsed.

facts.label: Suction claim
facts.meaning: Do not confuse suction with the spray-pressure claim.

facts.label: Airflow claim
facts.meaning: Airflow and suction are different measurements.

facts.label: Mop system
facts.meaning: Assess stain removal on a floor material like yours.

faq.question: Is the 46,000 Pa figure vacuum suction?
faq.answer: No. ECOVACS uses that figure for its stain-treatment water jets. The global page lists vacuum suction separately at up to 22,000 Pa.

launchNote: Featured in ECOVACS’ CES 2026 lineup. The exact first announcement date is not confirmed here; local sales dates vary.

name: Dyson V16 Piston Animal
summary: A manually operated cordless vacuum emphasizing hair handling and a dust-compacting bin.
fit: Pet owners and households needing direct control on stairs, upholstery and mixed floors.
caution: Handle the machine before purchase: balance, trigger-free operation and tool changes matter more than peak power alone.

facts.label: Suction claim
facts.meaning: Measured at the inlet in Boost mode under the stated test.

facts.label: Cleaner head
facts.meaning: A dual-cone head for hair management and floor adaptation.

facts.label: Dust handling
facts.meaning: Compaction does not remove the need to empty the bin.

facts.label: Product type
facts.meaning: This is a manually guided vacuum, not an autonomous robot.

faq.question: Is V16 Piston Animal a wet floor washer?
faq.answer: The standard cordless vacuum and the V16 Piston Animal Submarine wet-and-dry package are distinct. Confirm the exact package and compatible wet head before buying for floor washing.

launchNote: Announced in September 2025. Its 2026 US availability does not make it a new 2026 model.

name: MOVA LiDAX Ultra 1000
summary: A wire-free mower using LiDAR and vision for smaller lawns, with model-specific terrain limits.
fit: Owners wanting a wire-free installation on a modest lawn with manageable slopes.
caution: Keep this non-AWD model separate from the LiDAX Ultra AWD range when comparing traction.

facts.label: Rated lawn size
facts.meaning: Leave capacity headroom for split zones and limited mowing time.

facts.label: Navigation
facts.meaning: Test mapping in narrow passages and around dense planting.

facts.label: Slope claim
facts.meaning: Percent gradient is not degrees; traction depends on conditions.

facts.label: Cutting height
facts.meaning: Check the chosen regional SKU against your grass requirements.

faq.question: Is LiDAX Ultra 1000 an all-wheel-drive mower?
faq.answer: This profile is for the non-AWD listing. MOVA also markets models explicitly labeled AWD; do not transfer their slope or traction claims to this one.

sources.label: Official product page · United States · non-AWD

launchNote: The LiDAX Ultra series, including the 1000, was unveiled on 6 January 2026. European availability was announced for 27 January; other markets differ.

name: Mammotion LUBA mini 2 AWD 1500
summary: A compact all-wheel-drive mower with a dedicated edge disc and LiDAR-based navigation.
fit: Lawns where slope traction and the amount of remaining edge trimming deserve close attention.
caution: Verify the navigation version and boundary slope rules; a maximum slope claim is not a safe operating plan.

facts.label: Rated lawn size
facts.meaning: Capacity is not a promise to finish every layout in one charge.

facts.label: Drive / slope
facts.meaning: 80% corresponds to about 38.6°, subject to operating conditions.

facts.label: Navigation
facts.meaning: The referenced EU listing says no RTK antenna is required.

facts.label: Edge disc
facts.meaning: The dedicated disc helps near edges but does not eliminate all trimming.

faq.question: Does every LUBA mini 2 AWD 1500 use the same navigation?
faq.answer: Do not assume so from the family name. This profile follows the EU LiDAR listing checked on the date below; confirm the exact hardware revision and manual with the seller.

sources.label: Official product page · Europe · LiDAR listing
Manual library · match your hardware version

launchNote: Mammotion identifies LUBA mini 2 AWD as a 2026 launch. This profile covers the 1500 LiDAR listing; its exact regional announcement date is not confirmed here.

name: Sunseeker S4
summary: A wire-free mower combining 3D LiDAR, vision and automatic mapping for residential lawns.
fit: Owners prioritizing installation simplicity and mapping without a boundary wire or external antenna.
caution: Confirm the local area rating and cutting-height range; do not import an EU capacity label into a US offer.

facts.label: Navigation
facts.meaning: Check shaded routes, planting and reflective surfaces in a demonstration.

facts.label: Slope claim
facts.meaning: Inspect traction and turning room on the actual slope.

facts.label: Passage guidance
facts.meaning: Measure the usable corridor, including overhanging plants.

facts.label: Mapping
facts.meaning: Walk the resulting boundaries and verify no-go areas.

faq.question: Does S4 require a boundary wire or antenna station?
faq.answer: The cited S4 overview describes operation without either, using LiDAR and vision. You still need to establish a suitable charging location and verify the map and exclusions.

sources.label: Official product page · United States product overview

launchNote: Sunseeker’s official newsroom records the S4’s US debut at Equip Expo in October 2025. Its CES 2026 award is not a 2026 launch.

name: Aiper Scuba V3 Ultra
summary: A cordless pool cleaner emphasizing broad zone coverage, shallow-area cleaning and fine filtration.
fit: Pools where benches, shallow shelves and a mixture of floating and settled debris need attention.
caution: A minimum depth does not guarantee access to every shelf; check approach angles and surface compatibility.

facts.label: Shallow-area claim
facts.meaning: Shelf access also depends on its shape and entry route.

facts.label: Flow claim
facts.meaning: Manufacturer pump-flow figure, not measured cleaning throughput.

facts.label: Debris basket
facts.meaning: Debris type and filter loading affect emptying frequency.

facts.label: Perception
facts.meaning: Ask for a demonstration with the debris found in your pool.

faq.question: Will it clean every tanning ledge?
faq.answer: No universal guarantee follows from the stated 20 cm minimum. Check the ledge depth, width, access angle and surface, ideally with a demonstration in comparable geometry.

launchNote: Unveiled in Aiper’s CES 2026 smart yard lineup. Announcement and local retail availability are separate milestones.

name: Beatbot AquaSense X
summary: A pool robot and cleaning-station system aimed at reducing routine filter-rinsing work.
fit: Owners who value easier filter care and have suitable deck space for the service station.
caution: The robot must be lifted from the pool and placed on the station; allow for both robot and station maintenance.

facts.label: Service station
facts.meaning: Station placement, water management and access need planning.

facts.label: Navigation
facts.meaning: Pool geometry still determines reachable cleaning zones.

facts.label: Battery claim
facts.meaning: Capacity alone does not predict a completed cleaning cycle.

facts.label: Coverage modes
facts.meaning: Compare runtime in the same cleaning mode, not mixed maximums.

faq.question: Does AquaSense X automatically climb out into its cleaning station?
faq.answer: No. Its station automates filter washing after the owner retrieves the robot and places it on the station. This differs from an in-pool docking arrangement.

launchNote: Beatbot unveiled the AquaSense X ecosystem on 5 January 2026, ahead of CES. Regional packages and availability vary.

name: WYBOT S3
summary: A pool robot with a docking system for automatic recharging and debris transfer.
fit: Pool owners seeking fewer manual retrievals and willing to accommodate a fixed dock installation.
caution: Check dock geometry, power and maintenance access first; solar assistance does not guarantee continuous operation.

facts.label: Dock system
facts.meaning: Installation compatibility is part of the product decision.

facts.label: Shore debris bin
facts.meaning: A larger bin still needs scheduled cleaning.

facts.label: Navigation
facts.meaning: Validate the first map and difficult pool transitions.

facts.label: Power options
facts.meaning: Sunlight, shade and schedules affect the energy balance.

faq.question: Can solar charging run S3 continuously?
faq.answer: Do not assume that. WYBOT’s FAQ says three full days of direct sunlight can provide approximately 2.5 hours of runtime. Site conditions and the dock’s energy reserve matter.

launchNote: WYBOT unveiled the S3 at CES 2025. It is an earlier model, outside the 2026 new-model selection.
